column1: # mapping_set_description: The grades of the Dutch orders of civil merit and the candidate stages, ceremonies and offices of Dutch and Flemish student societies placed under the generic chivalric grades, member stages, ceremonies and offices.

column8: The lowest grade of the Order of Orange-Nassau.
The grade between Commander and Knight Grand Cross.
The highest grade of both orders.
The candidate member of a Dutch student society during the ontgroening.
The candidate member of a Flemish student society during the introductory period and the baptism.
The rite of passage with trials and tasks that candidates go through before they are received.
The ritual by which a candidate is inaugurated as a full member; a kind of initiation.
A gathering of singing and drinking governed by fixed rules, like the Kneipe of the German student traditions.
The chair of a student society; also presides at a cantus.
Runs the student baptism of the schachten; the novice master looks after novices for their whole time as novices, so the doopmeester is a narrower case.
